readerCopy.body: The people demanding proof may end up facing a movement that survives because its vision is larger than anything the current system can measure. Uranus opposite Neptune can put testable reform directly across from a collective ideal, especially when technology is being asked to carry hope, solidarity, or a future nobody can fully describe yet. Do not force the choice into belief versus cynicism. Test what can be tested. Keep the part of the vision that still matters after the tool, platform, or strategy has to answer for its results.
